appNotifDesc: Download complete, task end, and important error alerts
dataUntouched: No data was modified, and nothing was uploaded.
desktopNotifDesc: No system-level permission threshold on desktop.
desktopStorageDesc: Desktop uses app data directory directly; no permission needed.
featureCodeEditor: Code editor core (line numbers / find-replace / undo-redo / folding)
featurePermissions: Runtime permission requests and system settings entry
notifDesc: When enabled, receives rate limit warnings, download completions, sync failures, and other proactive alerts.
notifNoAuth: No notification authorization required on this platform.
permNotifyProblem: System notifications are disabled: alerts for rate limiting, download completion, and background tasks will only appear in-app and won't reach you when the app is in the background. Enable notifications for this app in your system settings.
permSelfTestPending: Self-test not yet completed in this session
permStorageProblem: Missing 'File Access' permission: logs and downloads will only be saved to the app's private directory, invisible to external tools (file manager / computer), and cannot be exported for troubleshooting. Grant this app 'Files and media / All files access' in your system settings, then restart the app.
storageGrantDesc1: Once granted, logs and downloaded files can be written to system-visible ogl folder;
storageGrantDesc2: If not granted, falls back to app-private directory (no functionality impact).
storageHintModern: On Android 11 or higher, the 'All files access' permission is required to write to the system-visible ogl directory. If your system or ROM does not offer this toggle (allowing only per-folder permissions), files will fall back to the app's private directory. Functionality remains intact, but they will typically not be visible in file managers.
storageSandbox: Current platform runs in app sandbox; no extra storage permission needed.
systemNotifUnavailable: System notifications unavailable (background alerts will only be logged): {error}
webNotifDesc: Web does not provide notification capabilities required by this app.
webStorageDesc: Browser environment manages storage quota itself; no app request needed.
webNotifGatewayDesc: A browser allows notifications only after you agree: the button below opens the browser's own permission prompt. Changing that later must be done in the browser's site settings — the app cannot open that page for you.
webMouseNoticeBody: Right-click = back; hold the left button = long-press menu; click = tap (same as mobile); touch gestures are disabled.
